### UTC Date & Time

October 8, 2026, 14:00 UTC

### Agenda

- Glamsterdam
  - Sepolia fork
  - Scheduling the Hoodi fork: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/pull/2263
  - Confirm gas limit change timing
- Hegotá
  - Complexity assessments [ @danceratopz ]
  - Brainstorming [speeding up & parallelizing fork work](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2227#issuecomment-5929953249) [ @LukaszRozmej ]
  - [PFI 7907](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2234#issuecomment-5893875075): 7954 in Glam raised the contract limit size w/out metering, creating an (expensive) DoS surface [ @benaadams ]
  - 11 EIPs left needing decisions:
    - Likeliest consensus: PAY opcode ([5920](https://forkcast.org/eips/5920/)), ecRecover ([8151](https://forkcast.org/eips/8151/)), `SETCODEFROM` ([8298](https://forkcast.org/eips/8298/))
    - Continued from last time: `TCREATE` Opcode ([8360](https://forkcast.org/eips/8360/)), Deactivate `SELFDESTRUCT` ([4758](https://forkcast.org/eips/4758/))
    - Potential DFIs: EVM-ify the identity precompile ([7666](https://forkcast.org/eips/7666/)) & read `BLOCKHASH` from storage ([7709](https://forkcast.org/eips/7709/)), eth/xx ([8077](https://forkcast.org/eips/8077/))
    - ??: Replace cumulative receipt fields ([8116](https://forkcast.org/eips/8116/)), Precompiles for ML-DSA Verification ([8355](https://forkcast.org/eips/8355/)), Persist Warm Access Sets Across Reverts ([8374](https://forkcast.org/eips/8374/))
- Misc
  - https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2234#issuecomment-6049553242 [ @abcoathup ]

comments.body: Based on the JumpDest benchmarking I would like to add [EIP-7907](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7907) for PFI/CFI consideration for Hegota
I would like to propose same speedup as I wanted on ACDC (didn't get to it due to hardfork scoping): https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2227#issuecomment-5929953249

> I would like to propose same speedup as I wanted on ACDC (didn't get to it due to hardfork scoping): [#2227 (comment)](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2227#issuecomment-5929953249)

Maybe I should actually join the EF on second thought

## Bunker mode

Should we view Hegotá scoping through the lens of bunker mode for maximum defensive acceleration?

https://x.com/drakefjustin/status/2107837081313505768

@LukaszRozmej - i'm going to put this before hegotá scoping but i think it's best if we timebox to 2-3 minutes on this call to get the idea out there and set a (non-scoping) time to think on it. Mumbai would be a really good venue to do brainstorming :)
